CLARIFICATIONS No. 1 - ITB MCWA/ITB/2027/014
Q1: Is the deadline for requests for clarification extendable?
A1: The deadline for requests for clarification stated in the Bid Data Sheet is amended to 10 June 2027.
Q2: Is the bid guarantee validity 120 or 90 days?
A2: The validity of 120 days stated in clause 4.1 remains unchanged.
Q3: May bidders submit by e-mail?
A3: No. Clause 1.2 applies.
